sqlText: SELECT count(0) FROM WARN_RULE_TOTAL WRT INNER JOIN EMP_MSG_RMNDR_RULE ER ON ER.STATUS = '1' AND ER.EMP_ID = WRT.EMP_ID AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER_QW SUQ WHERE ER.EMP_ID = SUQ.USER_ID) AND ER.EVENT_TP = WRT.WARN_SUB_CD WHERE (WRT.WARN_SUB_CD = 'EVENT_TP1_6_6') AND WRT.WARN_ACCT_TYPE = '2' AND WRT.CUST_NO IS NOT NULL AND WRT.CUST_NM IS NOT NULL AND nvl(WRT.is_read, '0') = '0' AND nvl(WRT.we_send_flg, '0') = '0'
